facts.fact: JJ 独自站在 Boar Lane 的 The Observatory。
facts.anchor: Inside The Observatory on Boar Lane, JJ stood alone.

facts.fact: Arthur 与 Charlie 未到，Matty 在男厕。
facts.anchor: Arthur and Charlie hadn’t turned up yet, Matty was in the gents’

facts.fact: 他还没想好解释 Emily 缺席的说法。
facts.anchor: Hadn’t thought of a good enough story to explain Emily’s absence.

facts.fact: Matty 向 Arthur、Charlie 自我介绍为 Jake 的室友 Matthew 并买一轮。
facts.anchor: ‘I’m Jake’s flatmate, Matthew. What are you two drinking, I’ll get this round?’

facts.fact: Arthur 直接问他们把 Emily 怎么了。
facts.anchor: What have you done with Emily?’

facts.fact: 之后他的记忆断片，直接跳到随众人去俱乐部。
facts.anchor: The next thing JJ remembered of the night was walking the short distance to the club

facts.fact: 他记得 Alice 和 Gareth 也出现在俱乐部。
Alice 问 Emily 是不是喝昏过去了。
facts.anchor: Where’s Emily, then?’ she asked. ‘Drank herself unconscious in the end?’
Matty turned on his heel and vanished
